headline: BOS @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.84 at CLE 3.34, with a projected total of 7.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved +0.09 runs while CLE moved -1.12, changing the projected margin by +1.21 runs. The projected total fell -1.03, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tyler Samaniego has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willson Contreras, Travis Bazzana, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kyle Manzardo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
